t_advice_summary_textbox.text: If you find yourself getting more than five mushrooms with a particular colour gnome keep picking that colour. If not try the other colour. Gnomes are always paired in the same two colours. If you want to change colour, do it on x1 not x5.

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes usually give between 1 and 7 points. Each pair always appear together in the same colour combination. Try to remember which colour gnome paid the highest number from each pair and keep choosing the same colour. If that gnome starts paying 4 or less change to the other gnome and keep choosing that one until that one starts paying less. Try to change when only x1 is displayed so you don't risk as many points.
